# Observing the Orion Nebula

The ecliptic is tilted about 23.4 degrees to the celestial equator because of the tilt of the Earth. Seeing describes air turbulence, while transparency describes haze and humidity. Right ascension is measured in hours along the celestial equator, and declination in degrees north or south of it. The Orion Nebula is visible to the naked eye as a soft glow in the sword of the hunter.

## Steps

- Averted vision helps: looking slightly to the side of a faint object uses the more sensitive part of the retina.
- Saturn rings tilt over a fifteen year cycle, so their appearance slowly changes from year to year.
